subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear Guest, We are pleased to confirm your reservation at our hotel for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your check-in date is scheduled for June 15th, 2022, and your check-out date is June 20th, 2022. If you have any special requests or need to make changes to your reservation, please contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel and ensuring you have a comfortable stay. Best regards, The Hotel Team
